units.source_text: 皇上宣召源氏内大臣及权中纳言上殿。

en.t: The emperor summoned Genji, the Minister of the Interior, and the Acting Middle Counselor to come up to the palace hall.

units.source_text: 这一天源氏的皇弟帅皇子也来觐见。

en.t: On that day, Genji's imperial younger brother, Prince Sochi, also came to pay his respects.

units.source_text: 这位皇子生性爱好风雅，对绘画尤感兴趣。

en.t: This prince was by nature fond of refined elegance and was especially interested in painting.

units.source_text: 大约是源氏内大臣预先暗中劝他来的，故并无正式宣召，恰巧于此时入觐。

en.t: It was probably because Genji, the Minister of the Interior, had secretly urged him to come beforehand; so although there had been no formal summons, he happened to enter for an audience at just that time.

units.source_text: 皇上便召他上殿，任命他为评判人。

en.t: The emperor then called him up to the hall and appointed him as a judge.
